items.reason: A gentle cleanser keeps your routine comfortable and leaves skin ready for a night active.
A starter-strength retinol is a sensible single active for smoother-looking texture without overloading skin.
A ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable skin barrier and helps balance dryness from retinol.
A mineral SPF 50 is essential every morning when using retinol, which increases sun sensitivity.

response.routine_note: Use the retinol at night just 2 nights a week at first, build up slowly as skin tolerates it, then follow with moisturizer, and wear SPF every morning. We left out the glycolic toner and benzoyl peroxide wash because layering all three actives at once is likely to irritate and won't get you results faster, but you can add one later once your skin is comfortable.
